name: version
comment: Stores the current database version. Version number is major.minor.

columns.name: major
columns.comment: The first part of the version number.

columns.name: minor
columns.comment: The second part of the version number.

name: metals
comment: Stores information about metals and alloys

columns.name: metal_id
columns.comment: Unique value for indexing metals. Should be periodic or chemical formula

columns.name: name
columns.comment: Proper name of the metal. This is what will be displayed when referencing the metal

columns.name: price
columns.comment: The price of the metal per troy ounce

columns.name: price_date
columns.comment: The date that the value of the price column was gathered

columns.name: series
columns.comment: Which series of data this metal belongs to

columns.name: tag_id
columns.comment: Unique value for indexing tags. Used by various tables to reference the tag

columns.name: bullion
columns.comment: Whether the issue is bullion (Made purely for its precious metal content)

name: countries
comment: Stores information about countries (or other issuing bodies)

columns.name: country_id
columns.comment: Unique value for indexing countries. Should be the ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code where applicable. If not available, use a code of at least 4 characters.

columns.name: display_name
columns.comment: Proper name of the country. This is what will be displayed when referencing the country

columns.name: tags
columns.comment: Tags associated with the country as a whole

columns.name: series
columns.comment: Which series of data this country belongs to

name: country_names
comment: Stores all of the names associated with a country. Used for search functionality

columns.name: name
columns.comment: Name to be tied to a country

columns.name: country_id
columns.comment: Country the name will be associated with

columns.name: denomination_id
columns.comment: Unique id for the denomination. Should be composed of <parent_country_id>_<something>.

columns.name: country_id
columns.comment: References the parent country of the denomination

columns.name: display_name
columns.comment: Proper name of the denomination. This is what will be displayed when referencing the denomination

columns.name: tags
columns.comment: Tags associated with the denomination as a whole

columns.name: series
columns.comment: Which series of data this denomination belongs to

name: denomination_names
comment: Stores all of the names associated with a denomination. Used for search functionality

columns.name: name_id
columns.comment: Denominations from different countries can have the same names. This is a unique index for the table.

columns.name: name
columns.comment: Name to be tied to a denomination

columns.name: denomination_id
columns.comment: Denomination the name will be associated with

columns.name: value_id
columns.comment: Unique id for the face values. Should be composed of <parent_denomination_id>_<something>.

columns.name: denomination_id
columns.comment: References the parent denomination of the face values

columns.name: value
columns.comment: The numeric value of the face value

columns.name: display_name
columns.comment: Proper name of the face value. If set, this is what will be displayed along with the numeric value

columns.name: tags
columns.comment: Tags associated with the face value as a whole

columns.name: series
columns.comment: Which series of data this face value belongs to

name: face_values_names
comment: Stores all of the names associated with a face value. Used for search functionality

columns.name: name_id
columns.comment: Face values from different denominations can have the same names. This is a unique index for the table.

columns.name: name
columns.comment: Name to be tied to a face value

columns.name: value_id
columns.comment: Face value that the name will be associated with

columns.name: coin_id
columns.comment: Unique id for the coins. Should be composed of <parent_value_id>_<something>.

columns.name: face_value_id
columns.comment: References the parent face value of the coin

columns.name: gross_weight
columns.comment: The weight of the coin

columns.name: fineness
columns.comment: The fineness of the coin as a decimal

columns.name: precious_metal_weight
columns.comment: The weight of the precious metal in the coin

columns.name: metal
columns.comment: The metal that the coin is made of

columns.name: name
columns.comment: Proper name of the coin. If set, this will be displayed with the coin.

columns.name: tags
columns.comment: Tags associated with the coin

columns.name: series
columns.comment: Which series of data this coin belongs to

name: years
comment: Stores which years coins were available in

columns.name: coin_id
columns.comment: Which coin this year applies to

columns.name: tags
columns.comment: Tags associated with the coin year

name: specific_coins
comment: Stores information about a singular coin

columns.name: coin_id
columns.comment: Which coin this specific coin belongs to

columns.name: coin_id
columns.comment: Which coin this purchase belongs to

columns.name: purchase_date
columns.comment: The date of the purchase

columns.name: unit_price
columns.comment: The price of each coin in the purchase

columns.name: purchase_quantity
columns.comment: The number of coins in the purchase.
